failure: depth topology bake changed the calibrated projected guide scale
root_cause: V2 copied the evaluated mesh into the source object's local data while retaining the source object transform. The retained MPFB evaluated-object transform/local-space relationship is not identity-equivalent, so the frozen guide no longer occupied the same world-space geometry used during camera calibration.
correction: V3 transforms evaluated vertices into exact world coordinates before freezing, removes parenting/modifiers, sets object matrix to identity, and asserts projected-height invariance <= 0.25 px.
architecture_impact: none; hidden-3D full-pose guide architecture remains current
